risks.risk: What the IBC was previously used for (chemical compatibility/contamination). Photos don’t show prior contents or cleaning status.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photos of any label/markings on the IBC (previous contents/UN code), plus a photo of the inside outlet/valve area and a cleaning/flush receipt if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used IBC that may be contaminated/unknown previous contents (treated as not suitable for sensitive chemicals).

risks.risk: Leakage or damage (cracks in plastic, bent cage, faulty valve). Outdoor photo doesn’t confirm integrity.
risks.proof: Video/clip showing the valve operation and a close-up of the tank seams, bottom corner, and outlet fitting; include a fill-and-drain test or leak check confirmation.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially needing inspection/repair and assume no guarantee of leak-free condition.

risks.risk: Capacity/size uncertainty (e.g., 1000L vs other). Photo doesn’t show capacity marking.
risks.proof: Photo of the capacity marking/sticker on the IBC (e.g., 1000L) and the manufacturer plate.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest common buyer expectation for an IBC (and treat as standard used IBC without confirmed capacity).

risks.risk: Whether it includes sand/media (seller mentions white sand, but photo shows only IBC tanks).
risks.proof: Photo showing the sand inside (open top view) or a clear statement with photos of the sand bagging/quantity.

proof_requests: Send close-up photos of the IBC label/plate (brand, model, capacity, and any previous contents/UN markings).
Send a video showing the outlet valve/drain tap working and a leak check (or a short fill test).
If sand is included: send a photo/video of the sand inside the IBC (open top) and the quantity/grade.
Confirm whether the IBC is food-grade/chemical-grade (with any documentation) if the buyer intends chemical use.
response.reason: The photo shows used IBC tanks, but the seller’s claims about “white sand” and chemical/cholesterol resistance are not supported by any visible label, certification, or proof.
